Verified on this model: shader rendering, smoke creation/motion, frozen clock, wake cleanup, original material restoration and repeated transitions. Review images and checks: Assets/Verification~/MeshyDreamCharger/.
This local source is unrigged. It is a visual prefab, not yet wired into the combat spawn roster. Charge/jump/death animations and combat integration remain pending. Other new Meshy models have not yet received visual-prefab integration in this pass.
